projects.name: Monarch Compute Campus (acquired via American Intelligence & Power Corporation)
projects.notes: Nscale's release (PR Newswire, dateline 17 March 2026, reached through an AAP reprint) says it agreed to acquire American Intelligence & Power Corporation (AIPCorp), which holds the Monarch Compute Campus: 'a site with up to 2,250 acres in Mason County, West Virginia', described as the first state-certified AI microgrid in the United States with a power runway scalable to over 8 gigawatts. Initial power of 2 gigawatts is expected online by the first half of 2028, with expansion to approximately 8 gigawatts planned for 2031, so power_mw is the planned maximum, not built capacity. acreage is the 'up to' figure. The deal also creates Nscale Energy & Power, headquartered in Houston, Texas. The acquisition was signed but not yet reported closed. Nscale's own newsroom was not reachable, so this rests on the company release as reprinted.
projects.source_title: Nscale — Nscale Acquires American Intelligence & Power Corporation (PR Newswire release, 17 Mar 2026; reprinted by AAP)
verbatims: The acquisition secures the Monarch Compute Campus, a site with up to 2,250 acres in Mason County, West Virginia, and the United States' first state-certified AI microgrid with a power runway scalable to over 8 gigawatts.
Initial power capacity of 2 gigawatts is expected to be online by the first half of 2028 with an expansion to approximately 8 gigawatts planned for 2031.
It also establishes Nscale Energy & Power, a new global division of Nscale headquartered in Houston, Texas.

projects.name: Goodman LAX01 Vernon (Los Angeles)
projects.notes: The Motley Fool Australia (24 March 2025), reporting Goodman's release, describes a 49.5 MW data centre in Vernon, California that is Goodman's first US data centre, with construction begun and the three-level facility 'set to provide an estimated 32MW of critical IT capacity'. power_mw is the 49.5 MW facility figure; 32 MW is IT capacity. The article's date is the reporting date, so the event date is approximate. Goodman's own ASX announcement was not reached. A November 2025 update (about 150 MW among FY26 projects) is secondary and not used. No Chicago or Atlanta site was found.
projects.source_title: The Motley Fool Australia — Goodman begins building its first U.S data centre (24 Mar 2025, reporting Goodman's release)
verbatims: It is a 49.5 MW data centre in Vernon, California.
the three-level facility is set to provide an estimated 32MW of critical IT capacity

company_summary_updates.nscale: UK-based AI data-centre developer, tracked for its proposed Loughton, Essex site, which has drawn objections from the town council over cooling and energy demand. It also has a US operation: in March 2026 it agreed to acquire American Intelligence & Power Corporation, which holds the Monarch Compute Campus in Mason County, West Virginia, and created a Houston-based Nscale Energy & Power division. No community-impact page was found in the research.
company_summary_updates.goodman: Australian property group tracked for its withdrawn 90 MW Project Mars application in Lane Cove, NSW. It also has a US operation: a 49.5 MW data centre in Vernon, California, described as its first in the United States. No community-impact page was found in the research.
company_summary_updates.segro: No change. No US data-centre operation was found: the FY2025 results announcement of 20 February 2026 does not mention the United States (probe miss), so this is a negative finding, not a record.
